tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The RFP has been addressed to all the Consultancy firms willing to provide PMC Services for the aforesaid Project in Karnataka. The consultant should have an office in Karnataka with a valid GST number. In case of Joint Venture either of the partners should have an office in Karnataka. The consultant should enclose GST filed details for last one year.

The Client will provide the inputs specified in the Data Sheet, assist the firm in obtaining licenses and permits needed to carry out the services, and make available relevant project data and reports.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Project Management Consultancy Services / Authority Engineer Supervision Services in Survey, Design, Construction of 6/8 Lane Access Controlled, Green Field Expressway Project with a Project Cost of not less than Rs. 1350.00 Crores within the last five years (i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-2026). The project of previous years will be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the FY in which the tenders are invited

Project Management Consultancy Services / Authority Engineer Supervision Services which includes at least one project with construction of 6/8 lane access controlled, green field expressway for a minimum length of 42km within last five years. (i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-2026).

Project Management Consultancy Services / Authority Engineer Supervision Services for 6/8 Lane access controlled, green field expressway projects for a minimum structural length (Structures including but not limited to Major bridges, Minor Bridges, VOP, VUP, Viaducts) of 1km in single work for Government / Government Undertaking Organizations only.

The consultant should have carried out PMC/Authority Engineer Supervision Services for construction of 6/8 lane access controlled, green field expressway projects equipped with Advance Traffic Management System (ATMS)
